**PLEASE DO NOT OPEN FEATURE REQUEST ISSUES ON GITHUB**

**Feature requests should be opened on our dedicated feature request hub so they can be appropriately discussed and prioritized.**

However, if you are willing to contribute to Kelso Media Server by adding a new feature yourself, please first review our [contribution documentation](https://docs.jellyfin.org/general/contributing/development.html). After reviewing the documentation, you may return here and open an issue outlining your proposed approach so it can be documented and discussed by the team.
